title: A Phase 3 Study of CBP501 + Cisplatin + Nivolumab versus Physician’s Choice of Therapy for ≥3rd Line Treatment of Patients with Advanced Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma [FUJI-PanC01]
official: A Phase 3, Open-Label, Multicenter, Randomized Study of a Combination of CBP501, Cisplatin and Nivolumab or Physician’s Choice of Therapy for ≥3rd Line Treatment of Patients with Advanced Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma
summary:
Main objective: Evaluate overall survival (OS)
Determine whether there is a statistically significant difference in OS between
CBP501/cisplatin/nivolumab therapy (Triplet, arm1) versus physician’s choice of therapy
(Control, arm 2) in the ITT population.
conditions: Pathologically confirmed stage IV pancreatic adenocarcinoma
Malignant neoplasm of pancreatic duct recurrent
